job: Add files by dropping them or browsing; one image as a settings row for a logo.
purpose: A dashed, sunken area that is also a button: click or press Enter to browse, or drop files. Accepted files appear as rows with progress, status and size. fd:files is cancelable so your app can run the upload and report with setFileProgress(); data-max-mb and accept reject files that do not fit. With data-layout="logo" it is one row for a single image: preview, Upload, Remove, a progress bar and a field error. Fire uploads nothing.
useWhen: People attach one or several files, such as a sitemap, a CSV or a document.
Upload progress and per-file errors should show as rows.
A team uploads its logo or another single image in a settings row, with a preview and a way to remove it.

avoidWhen.when: One small file is chosen as part of a plain form and no progress is needed.
The upload is a person's profile photo that is cropped to a circle.
Files are only listed, not added.

states.name: dragover
states.how: data-state="dragover" while files are dragged over it

states.name: error
states.how: data-state="error" on a file row, with a reason in .fd-file-status

states.name: logo error
states.how: data-state="error" on a data-layout="logo" row, with the reason in the field's .fd-field-error

variants.useWhen: A compact one-line dropzone in a form row.
A single image with a preview, Upload and Remove, in a settings row.

parts.role: The drop area; a label around the file input.
The icon that lifts on drag.
Progress, ready or the reason it failed.
The logo row's preview tile: the current picture, or the initial tile.
The logo row's Upload and Remove buttons.
